meta.baseline: TomKal1/QuickerPlaces@ba6ad88 (the violet dark theme, recorded as version 1 of this system)
meta.inspiration: Saab 900: dark green paint, tan leather, silver trim, black dash with orange needles, red tail lights

tokens.name: Bg-Base
tokens.usage: The window ground: dash black in dark, studio silver-white in light.

tokens.name: Bg-Panel
tokens.usage: Lists, tables and grouped panels (the Recents calendar).

tokens.name: Bg-Raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, table headers, chips, the status bar, the count badge, keycaps.

tokens.name: Bg-Sunken
tokens.usage: Text inputs: the search box and the shortcut box.

tokens.name: Bg-TitleBar
tokens.usage: The window title bar.

tokens.name: Bg-RowHover
tokens.usage: A list row under the pointer.

tokens.name: Border-Default
tokens.usage: Row dividers, panel and table outlines, section dividers in dialogs.

tokens.name: Border-Strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of interactive controls: buttons, inputs, chips, segmented controls. Only about 1.9:1 (dark) and 1.7:1 (light) against Bg-Base, so a control is never marked by its outline alone: it also has a Bg-Raised or Bg-Sunken fill and a label or icon.

tokens.name: Text-Primary
tokens.usage: Everything a person reads, on every surface.

tokens.name: Text-Secondary
tokens.usage: Subheaders, hints, labels in capitals, column headers, the Type and path columns. 6:1 or better on Bg-Base, Bg-Panel and Bg-Raised in both themes.

tokens.name: Text-Tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, keyboard hints, 'Paused', calendar labels. 4.5:1 or better on Bg-Base, Bg-Panel, Bg-Raised and Bg-RowHover in both themes (dark was #7f8683 until the app build, which fell to 4.2:1 on Bg-Raised). Still only for hints and placeholders, never for content; on a Highlight-Soft wash use Text-Secondary.

tokens.name: Trim-Stripe
tokens.usage: The upper band of the racing stripe under each window's header: 4px, full width, silver in dark and near-black in light, with a 4px Highlight band straight below it. Replaced Trim-Band (a 7px dark band with a 1px Trim-Line pinstripe) after the app build.

tokens.name: Trim-Line
tokens.usage: The 1px silver ring around the monogram.

tokens.name: Brand-Green
tokens.usage: The app icon (and the tiny monogram in the title bar, which is the app icon), in both themes. Fixed: it does not follow the highlight choice. The header monogram used it until the app build; it now fills with Highlight.

tokens.name: Highlight
tokens.usage: The user's highlight colour (default Hull green): Primary button fill (including Recents, Add folder and Add link in the main window header), the header monogram, the lower band of the racing stripe, selected row, on-state of segmented controls and checkboxes. The app swaps it for another preset's value at runtime.

tokens.name: Highlight-Hover
tokens.usage: Primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: Highlight-Text
tokens.usage: Highlight used as text or an icon on the ground: type glyphs in lists, the sort arrow and its 2px underline, 'Saved', success ticks, hover borders, the selected-week outline. 5.5:1 or better on Bg-Base in both themes.

tokens.name: Highlight-Soft
tokens.usage: A wash of the highlight behind a selected chip.

tokens.name: On-Highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Highlight, including the monogram's 'QP'. 5.5:1 or better on every preset's fill and 4.5:1 or better on every preset's hover, in both themes. For Windows accent the app picks white when white reaches 4.5:1, otherwise black.

tokens.name: Preset-Green
tokens.usage: Hull green preset (default): fill.

tokens.name: Preset-Green-Hover
tokens.usage: Hull green preset: fill under the pointer. Dark was #33866f until the app build; that gave white text only 4.4:1.

tokens.name: Preset-Green-Text
tokens.usage: Hull green preset: text and icons on the ground.

tokens.name: Preset-Green-Soft
tokens.usage: Hull green preset: wash.

tokens.name: Preset-Blue
tokens.usage: Steel blue preset: fill.

tokens.name: Preset-Blue-Hover
tokens.usage: Steel blue preset: fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: Preset-Blue-Text
tokens.usage: Steel blue preset: text and icons on the ground.

tokens.name: Preset-Blue-Soft
tokens.usage: Steel blue preset: wash.

tokens.name: Preset-Red
tokens.usage: Tail red preset: fill.

tokens.name: Preset-Red-Hover
tokens.usage: Tail red preset: fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: Preset-Red-Text
tokens.usage: Tail red preset: text and icons on the ground.

tokens.name: Preset-Red-Soft
tokens.usage: Tail red preset: wash.

tokens.name: Preset-Cognac
tokens.usage: Cognac preset: fill.

tokens.name: Preset-Cognac-Hover
tokens.usage: Cognac preset: fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: Preset-Cognac-Text
tokens.usage: Cognac preset: text and icons on the ground.

tokens.name: Preset-Cognac-Soft
tokens.usage: Cognac preset: wash.

tokens.name: Signal
tokens.usage: Gauge orange, for indicators only: favourite stars, today's calendar cell, the new-activity dot, the keyboard focus ring, warnings. (The sort arrow used it until the app build; it now follows the highlight.) About 4.3:1 on white in light, so use it for icons, lines and bold text there, not body text.

tokens.name: Danger
tokens.usage: Tail red, for errors and removing things only. 5.7:1 on Bg-Base in dark, 6.5:1 on Bg-Raised in light.

tokens.name: Info
tokens.usage: Information messages (the info badge).

tokens.name: Leather
tokens.usage: Tan leather: favourite cards and the visits bars in Recents. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: Leather-Deep
tokens.usage: The number badge on a favourite card.

tokens.name: On-Leather
tokens.usage: Text and icons on Leather. About 6:1.

tokens.name: On-Leather-Badge
tokens.usage: The number on a favourite card's Leather-Deep badge. 4.7:1 or better.

tokens.name: Heat-0
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: a tracked day with no visits (drawn with a Border-Default outline).

tokens.name: Heat-1
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: fewest visits.

tokens.name: Heat-2
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: some visits.

tokens.name: Heat-3
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: many visits.

tokens.name: Heat-4
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: most visits. Lightest in dark, darkest in light, so more visits always means more contrast with the ground.

tokens.name: Heat-Untracked
tokens.usage: Recents calendar: a day outside tracked history, including future days. Drawn with a Border-Default outline, because in dark the fill alone is almost Bg-Panel.

styles.name: title-window
styles.usage: The name at the top of a window: QuickerPlaces, Recents.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: The heading over a result, such as the Recents period.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Section labels, set in capitals in Text-Secondary: Favourites, All places, Tracked folders, Appearance.

styles.name: label-field
styles.usage: The name of a setting above its control.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your saved folders and links, one click away.
styles.usage: The window default: subheaders, table cells, messages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A place's name in the list, larger than the other columns so names are what the eye finds first.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented controls. Compact buttons use 13px.

styles.name: favourite
styles.usage: The name on a favourite card.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Colours the main button, selected rows and switches.
styles.usage: Help text under a setting; keyboard hints beside a label.

styles.name: calendar
styles.usage: Month and weekday labels on the Recents strip.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: Folder paths and links in tables and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between calendar cells and week columns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between legend cells.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between keycaps; icon-to-label gap in compact controls.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, between favourite cards, and between chips.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Label-to-hint gap in a row; space above a table or status bar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Horizontal cell padding; gap between a section label and its content.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a standard button; gap between the monogram and the title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the racing stripe; the bottom window padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Top window padding; space above the All places row.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Side window padding; space around dividers in dialogs.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog side padding.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Recents calendar cells.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Keycaps and the favourite number badge.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls and favourite cards.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Windows, tables, the status bar and the monogram tile.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Grouped panels, such as the Recents calendar.

tokens.name: radius-15
tokens.usage: Tracked-folder chips (a pill at 30px tall).

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: Highlight swatches in Settings (40px circles).

tokens.name: Shadow-Card
tokens.usage: Favourite cards: a faint top highlight and a small drop shadow.

tokens.name: Shadow-Primary
tokens.usage: The chrome-edge highlight along the top of the Primary button.

tokens.name: Shadow-Window
tokens.usage: Mockups only: a window on a backdrop. Windows draws the real one.
